title: The Duck Pond
objectives_ko: 글자 D·E·F의 이름과 소리를 알고 말한다
D·E·F로 시작하는 단어 9개를 듣고 말하고 찾는다
사이트워드 the, is를 보고 읽는다 (1유닛의 I, see, a 복습)

workbook.title: B. Circle the same letter.  C. Match and color.
D. Trace the words.  E. Color and say.
F. Read three times.  G. Sort the words.  H. Finish the story.

panels.desc: A sunny garden pond with lily pads. A yellow duck floats in the middle with a glowing golden seed resting on its back. Bun and Hedgie crouch at the edge of the pond pointing at the duck; Pip flutters above the water, glowing. Hidden in the picture: a small brown puppy sitting on the bank, a rag doll leaning against a watering can.

lines.text: The seed is on the duck.

panels.desc: Beside the pond, a hen's nest in the grass holds three white eggs, one of them glowing gold like a seed. Hedgie kneels and gently points at the glowing egg; Bun holds a finger to her lips. Behind them a new letter tree with duck-, dog- and doll-shaped fruits has sprouted. Hidden in the picture: a tiny elf peeking from behind a flower pot, a small green exit-style sign with a running figure on the garden shed door.

A green frog sits on a lily pad with a glowing seed on its head. Grumble the raccoon has tiptoed to the very edge of the pond with his lantern and is wobbling, about to fall into the water, arms flailing; Bun and Hedgie reach out to grab him; Pip looks alarmed. Hidden in the picture: a small blue electric fan on a garden table, a silver fork stuck in a picnic basket.

Bun and Hedgie have pulled Grumble out of the pond; he is dripping wet, wrapped in a towel, looking embarrassed but secretly pleased. Pip offers him a leaf as an umbrella. Three new letter trees (D, E, F with their fruits) stand by the pond behind them.

videos.prompt: Gentle picture-book animation: the yellow duck paddles slowly across the pond, ripples spread, the golden seed on its back twinkles, the rabbit and the hedgehog point excitedly, the green sprite bobs in the air. Camera still. Soft, child-friendly. No text.

Gentle comic picture-book animation: the grey raccoon wobbles at the pond edge with arms flailing, the frog blinks and hops once, the friends reach out, a few water drops splash. Camera still. Playful, child-friendly. No text.

Behind them the new D tree with duck-, dog- and doll-shaped fruits. Hidden in the picture: a tiny elf peeking from behind a flower pot, a green exit sign with a running figure on the shed door. Grumble has tiptoed right to the slippery edge of the pond, wobbling on one foot with his arms out and his lantern swinging.

SPLASH! Grumble sits in the shallow pond dripping wet, a green frog with a glowing seed on its head sitting on top of his nightcap. Bun and Hedgie pull him out by the paws; Pip holds a big leaf over him like an umbrella. Hidden in the picture: a small blue electric fan on a garden table, a silver fork in a picnic basket. His lantern, though wet, still glows, a little stronger than before.
